ValidationRule.description: Ensure incoming version of the settlement is not lower than version currently in Salesforce
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( PRIORVALUE(Version__c) > Version__c, PRIORVALUE(Nominated_Account_Version__c) > Nominated_Account_Version__c, PRIORVALUE(Repayment_Account_Version__c) > Repayment_Account_Version__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The version cannot be older than the current value
